title: Acyclicity of partial adder gates
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be natural numbers with $3k\le n$, and let $i$ be a natural number. The list formed by starting with two constant gates and appending $i$ successive bit blocks according to the ripple-carry construction is acyclic: each input index read by the gate at position $j$ is less than $n+j$.
caveat: The exact gate wiring in each bit block is specified only by upstream definitions whose informal descriptions are stubs.
